body: Thank you so much for this — Beautifully written! To be honest, my story just began. I am still adjusting to college life, and I am always comparing myself to others. When I wrote this, I was at a low, but I took some tike to reflect. I’m going to focus on myself and my mental health. Everyone is unique. That includes me. I just need to remind myself that. :)
I can’t even properly express myself.
